about.title: About the platform
about.lead: HyDroMa Nojin is an integrated platform for landscape restoration: from data and scientific models to markets, carbon and rural livelihoods.
about.what: The platform records land and landscape as a data profile, analyses it with documented scientific models (FAO-56, RUSLE, Richards, Saint-Venant) and returns results with an uncertainty range and explicit provenance.
about.audience: Farmers, pastoralists, cooperatives and local markets, public institutions, researchers and investors.
evidence: Real data from the platform database and services
Explicit source and date label on every number
limits: Heavy computation depends on the C++ core, which is unavailable in this environment
Field data is limited until the pilot begins
next: Fully connect the scientific tools to real data

services.lead: Practical starting points for pilots, field learning and data-informed decisions.
services.what: Each solution begins with a real problem, names the data and model it needs, and returns a result with explicit limits and provenance.

evidence: A recorded model version and analysis date

a11y.metaDescription: What this build measures about contrast and typefaces, what it does not claim, and how to report a barrier.
a11y.contrastBody: One gate measures every foreground and background token pair the stylesheet declares, in both the light and the dark scheme, against the WCAG floor for that pair.
a11y.contrastPass: every measured pair meets its own floor
a11y.fontsBody: The stylesheet declares three font families and eight font files. Every script the platform serves is listed below with what actually reaches the screen.
a11y.fontsFallback: Not shipped here; the reader's own installed font is used
a11y.fontsGap: A script in this column is drawn with a font already installed on the reader’s device, so its appearance is not controlled by this build. An empty list means no locale is in that state.
a11y.assistiveBody: Every interactive control is reachable and operable by keyboard, and the focus ring is never removed. A skip link is the first focusable element on every page.
a11y.inclusiveBody: The same content is reachable over USSD, SMS and voice, so a reader does not need a smartphone, a data plan or a modern browser.
a11y.notClaimedTitle: What this statement does not claim
notClaimedItems: No external accessibility audit has been carried out, so no conformance level is declared.
The two measurements below are a point-in-time record. A later build can differ, and the stamp says when the record was taken.
Screen-reader behaviour is not checked automatically by this build’s gate.
No usability study with assistive-technology users has been run.
WCAG conformance is a property of a release, not of this page.
a11y.feedbackBody: If any part of this site blocks you, say so and name the page. A barrier that is never reported cannot be prioritised.

why.title: Why Eco Nojin?
why.lead: This page says only what the checks that were run and the gateway counters support. Anything the platform cannot demonstrate is declared unavailable rather than filled in.
why.problemBody: Smallholders make the majority of the food that is eaten, and they are the group least served by the data and advice available to them. Soil, water and climate decisions are made under uncertainty, without a record of what was decided or why.
why.solutionBody: One platform that puts the scientific record next to the field: models that name their version, provenance for every value, and a market that pays for what is actually grown.
why.evidenceBody: Every figure on this platform carries its source, its method version and the limits the method declares. Where a value is reported rather than measured, the page says so rather than presenting the two as the same thing.
why.limitsBody: It does not replace local knowledge, and it does not claim a yield increase it has not measured. A model that does not apply to your soil is shown as not applying to your soil.
why.whatLead: One integrated ecological intelligence platform: a scientific engine, an API gateway, an offline-first client and an event bus.
why.whatDesc: Soil, hydrology, climate, erosion and carbon modelling behind one contract, with a client that works without a network.
why.audience: Farmers, cooperatives, researchers, planners and their funders

problemRows.problem: A farmer offline cannot reach a dashboard that assumes a connection.
problemRows.solution: The client holds the reference datasets and declares which surface is unavailable rather than showing a stale number as a current one.

problemRows.problem: A model result arrives with no way to tell a measurement from an estimate.
problemRows.solution: Every surface carries a provenance stamp naming the source, the method, and whether the value is verified.

problemRows.problem: A claim with no executed check behind it.
problemRows.solution: The only source of the platform’s claims is the verification suite, and its result is read live from the gateway.

evidenceItems: Every claim on this page is read at request time from the executed verification suite, not from a stored summary.
